info.title: airtable (WorkflowBench simulated)
info.description: Airtable REST API. Authorization: Bearer {token}. Rate limit: 5 req/sec per base. The {baseId} is the Airtable base (application) ID, {tableId} is the table name or ID.

get.summary: Enumerate the Airtable bases (applications) this account can access. Use this to discover a base's ID before reading its
get.description: Enumerate the Airtable bases (applications) this account can access. Use this to discover a base's ID before reading its tables or records.

get.summary: Enumerate the tables inside a given Airtable base. Returns each table's ID and display name for use with the record endp
get.description: Enumerate the tables inside a given Airtable base. Returns each table's ID and display name for use with the record endpoints.

parameters.name: baseId
parameters.description: Identifier of the Airtable base whose tables should be listed.

get.summary: Fetch or search records from an Airtable table. Use filterByFormula to narrow results to matching entries (e.g., "{Name}
get.description: Fetch or search records from an Airtable table. Use filterByFormula to narrow results to matching entries (e.g., "{Name}='Acme'").

parameters.name: baseId
parameters.description: Identifier for the Airtable base (application).

parameters.name: tableId
parameters.description: Name or identifier of the target table.

parameters.name: filterByFormula
parameters.description: An Airtable formula expression used to filter records, e.g. "{Status}='Active'".

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: A list of sort configuration objects, e.g. [{field: 'Name', direction: 'asc'}]. Each object specifies a field (string) and direction ('asc'|'desc').

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: List of field names to include in the response. Only the listed fields will be returned.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: How many records to return per page (maximum 100).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Continuation token from a prior response, used to retrieve the next page of results.

parameters.name: cellFormat
parameters.description: Determines how cell values are formatted: 'json' (default) or 'string'.

parameters.name: timeZone
parameters.description: Timezone to apply when rendering date values (e.g. 'America/New_York').

parameters.name: userLocale
parameters.description: Locale setting used for value formatting (e.g. 'en-us').

parameters.name: maxRecords
parameters.description: Upper limit on the total number of records to return.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Name or ID of a specific view to use when listing records.

200.description: {records: [{id, fields: {fieldName: value, ...}, createdTime}], offset (pagination token if more records exist)}
